purpose: Recorded samples for the sales list import proofs (Robert's CRM R2, 2026-11-02). Each was fetched once from the public source named, trimmed, and is read by scripts/proofs/the-imports-preview-dedupe-and-wait-for-a-person.mjs. No proof reaches a real portal.

san-antonio-permits.csv.trim: The header and 320 rows from the first 4 MB of the file: up to 70 rows of each kept permit type and 3 of each other type, in file order.

austin-permits.json.trim: 220 Socrata rows: 40 Roof, 80 Auxiliary Power naming solar or PV, 80 Repair naming foundation, and 20 Remodel that the filter must drop, newest first, selected columns only.

tdlr-electrical-contractors.csv.trim: The header and the first 200 rows of 14,058.

tdlr-solar-salespeople.csv.trim: The header and the first 200 rows of 1,684.

trec-license-holders.json.trim: 200 Socrata rows ordered by license number, every status and type, so the filter has something to drop.
